decisions.reason: The firm has publicized strong customer savings for this concept, it builds on the established portfolio, and management shaped by escalation of commitment would be reluctant to withdraw a visibly successful 2023 launch.

Although there is no reported quantified market success, it remains on its own webpage across 2023 and 2024, fits closely with the core machinery offer, and prior development and launch investments make continuation more likely than withdrawal.

As a flagship multi-model line tied to the firm's stated strategic direction and supported by a named customer reference plus quantified savings, this is the product management is least likely to abandon.

This newly launched multi-model shredder line is close to the firm's core business, recent launch costs are still salient, and in a growing firm management would typically give it more time rather than drop it quickly.

The new spiral shaft screen line extends the established offer and supports the firm's modular environmental-technology trajectory, so despite limited visible results so far, committed management would likely continue backing it for another year.
